title: S&P Cuts Meta Credit Outlook to Negative as AI Capex Hits $135–145B Annual Run Rate
summary: S&P Global revised Meta's credit outlook from stable to negative while keeping its AA- rating. Meta's capex guidance reached $135–145B per year, and free cash flow turned negative for the first time — a $2.12B deficit in Q3 2026. S&P warned it could downgrade if adjusted net debt-to-EBITDA rises above 1.0x and FCF stays negative past 2028.
why: 标普首次将Meta信用展望调负，AI资本开支失控叠加自由现金流转负，是Meta自2012年上市以来首次FCF负值；Sell Put策略须关注META期权隐含波动率可能扩张，短期Put行权价选择需为潜在降级风险预留缓冲。事件发生于10月30日，适逢本组合持有Meta衍生品头寸，信用变化对估值折现率有直接影响，属仍在市场消化中的重要信用事件。
